blocks.zh: Section 3: Part II Annex — QbD Elements, Design Space & Control Strategy｜附件：品質源於設計要素、設計空間與控制策略
blocks.en: Section 3: Part II Annex — QbD Elements, Design Space & Control Strategy

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Part II Annex 的定位：不建立新要求，而是闡明 QbD 工具的實際應用方式
blocks.en: Understand the positioning of the Part II Annex: it establishes no new requirements, but clarifies how QbD tools are applied in practice

blocks.zh: 掌握 QbD 最小要素（minimal elements）vs 增強方法（enhanced approach）的差異
blocks.en: Grasp the difference between the minimal elements of QbD and the enhanced approach

blocks.zh: 精確理解 QTPP 和 CQA 的官方定義，及其在製劑開發中的角色
blocks.en: Understand precisely the official definitions of QTPP and CQA and their roles in drug product development

blocks.zh: 理解風險評估如何將物料屬性和製程參數連結至 CQA
blocks.en: Understand how risk assessment links material attributes and process parameters to CQAs

blocks.zh: 掌握 Design Space 的六個子議題（2.4.1–2.4.6）：變數選擇、描述方式、單元操作、比例放大、PAR vs DS、失效邊界
blocks.en: Master the six sub-topics of Design Space (2.4.1-2.4.6): selection of variables, description, unit operations, scale-up, PAR vs DS, and failure edges

blocks.zh: 理解控制策略（Control Strategy）的完整框架及 RTRT 的應用條件
blocks.en: Understand the complete framework of the control strategy and the conditions for applying RTRT

blocks.zh: Annex 1: Introduction & Approaches to Pharmaceutical Development｜附件導論與開發方法論
blocks.en: Annex 1: Introduction & Approaches to Pharmaceutical Development

blocks.zh: 中文解析
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 重要澄清：Annex 不新增要求
blocks.en: Key clarification: the Annex adds no new requirements

blocks.zh: Q8 Annex 明確聲明：不建立新標準或引入新法規要求。這意味著：
blocks.en: The Q8 Annex explicitly states that it does not establish new standards or introduce new regulatory requirements. This means:

blocks.zh: 不採用 QbD 方法也可以通過審查，只要滿足最小要素
blocks.en: A submission can be approved without a QbD approach, as long as the minimal elements are met

blocks.zh: QbD 是「機會」不是「義務」——但選擇 QbD 路徑的申請方可享有更大彈性
blocks.en: QbD is an "opportunity", not an "obligation", but applicants who choose the QbD path enjoy greater flexibility

blocks.zh: 「知識的品質」比「數據的數量」更重要
blocks.en: The "quality of knowledge" matters more than the "quantity of data"

blocks.zh: 核心概念：QbD 最小要素 vs 增強方法
blocks.en: Core concept: minimal elements of QbD vs enhanced approach

blocks.zh: Annex 明確區分兩個層次，這是理解 Q8 監管期望的關鍵：
blocks.en: The Annex clearly distinguishes two levels, which is key to understanding regulatory expectations under Q8:

blocks.zh: 增強方法的回報：更大的操作彈性（Design Space 內不須補件）、支持 RTRT（取代部分終點測試）、潛在減少 post-approval change。
blocks.en: Rewards of the enhanced approach: greater operational flexibility (no supplement needed within the Design Space), support for RTRT (replacing some end-product testing), and potentially fewer post-approval changes.

blocks.zh: Annex 2.1 & 2.2: QTPP & CQA｜品質目標產品特性與關鍵品質屬性
blocks.en: Annex 2.1 & 2.2: QTPP & CQA

blocks.zh: QTPP：製劑設計的「目標設定書」
blocks.en: QTPP: the "target-setting brief" for drug product design

blocks.zh: QTPP（Quality Target Product Profile）是製劑開發的起點——定義了「理想中這個產品應該是什麼樣子」。它不是規格表，而是一份願景文件，驅動所有後續開發決策。
blocks.en: The QTPP (Quality Target Product Profile) is the starting point of drug product development: it defines what the ideal product should look like. It is not a specification sheet but a vision document that drives all subsequent development decisions.

blocks.zh: QTPP 的五個考量維度：
blocks.en: Five dimensions considered in the QTPP:

blocks.zh: 臨床用途：適應症、給藥途徑、劑型（如口服、注射、吸入）
blocks.en: Clinical use: indication, route of administration, dosage form (e.g., oral, injectable, inhalation)

blocks.zh: 劑量強度：治療劑量範圍
blocks.en: Dosage strength: therapeutic dose range

blocks.zh: 容器封閉：預期包裝形式
blocks.en: Container closure: intended packaging format

blocks.zh: 藥物釋放：溶出特性、氣動性能（對應 PK 目標）
blocks.en: Drug release: dissolution characteristics, aerodynamic performance (corresponding to PK targets)

blocks.zh: 品質標準：無菌性、純度、穩定性
blocks.en: Quality criteria: sterility, purity, stability

blocks.zh: 類比：QTPP 如同建築設計的需求說明書
blocks.en: Analogy: the QTPP is like the client brief for a building design

blocks.zh: 建設一棟建築前，業主會提出需求（幾層樓、使用功能、預算、耐震等級）。這份需求說明就是 QTPP——它驅動建築師（製劑科學家）的所有設計決策。若沒有清晰的 QTPP，開發方向可能偏離臨床需求。
blocks.en: Before a building is constructed, the owner states the requirements (number of floors, use, budget, seismic rating). This brief is the QTPP: it drives every design decision made by the architect (the formulation scientist). Without a clear QTPP, development may drift away from clinical needs.

blocks.zh: CQA：從 QTPP 推導的品質屬性清單
blocks.en: CQA: the list of quality attributes derived from the QTPP

blocks.zh: 官方定義：物理、化學、生物或微生物特性，必須在適當限度/範圍/分布內，以確保期望的產品品質。
blocks.en: Official definition: a physical, chemical, biological or microbiological property or characteristic that should be within an appropriate limit, range, or distribution to ensure the desired product quality.

blocks.zh: CQA vs 規格（Specification）的區別：
blocks.en: Difference between a CQA and a specification:

blocks.zh: CQA 是開發工具——識別哪些屬性需要被研究和控制
blocks.en: A CQA is a development tool: it identifies which attributes need to be studied and controlled

blocks.zh: 規格（spec）是監管要求——最終商業產品的驗收標準
blocks.en: A specification is a regulatory requirement: the acceptance criteria for the final commercial product

blocks.zh: CQA 列表在開發過程中是動態的，隨知識增加而修訂
blocks.en: The CQA list is dynamic during development and is revised as knowledge increases

blocks.zh: 不同劑型的特色 CQA：
blocks.en: Characteristic CQAs by dosage form:

blocks.zh: 固體口服：純度、效價、溶出、穩定性
blocks.en: Oral solid: purity, potency, dissolution, stability

blocks.zh: 吸入製劑：氣動粒徑分布（APSD）、MMAD
blocks.en: Inhalation products: aerodynamic particle size distribution (APSD), MMAD

blocks.zh: 注射劑：無菌性、微粒、可見/不可見異物
blocks.en: Injectables: sterility, particulates, visible/subvisible particles

blocks.zh: 貼片：黏附力、皮膚通透性
blocks.en: Patches: adhesion, skin permeation

blocks.zh: 原料藥 CQA 也影響製劑 CQA
blocks.en: Drug substance CQAs also affect drug product CQAs

blocks.zh: CQA 的概念延伸到原料藥和中間體——API 的粒徑分布（PSD）和堆積密度（bulk density）雖然是 API 的屬性，但直接影響製劑的含量均勻性（CQA）。
blocks.en: The CQA concept extends to drug substances and intermediates: the particle size distribution (PSD) and bulk density of the API, although attributes of the API, directly affect the content uniformity (a CQA) of the drug product.

blocks.zh: 這種「上游 CQA → 下游 CQA」的鏈結關係是風險評估的核心分析對象（見 2.3 節）。
blocks.en: This "upstream CQA to downstream CQA" linkage is the core subject of risk assessment analysis (see Section 2.3).

blocks.zh: Annex 2.3 & 2.4: Risk Assessment & Design Space｜風險評估與設計空間詳解
blocks.en: Annex 2.3 & 2.4: Risk Assessment & Design Space in Detail

blocks.zh: 2.3 風險評估：從「可能影響清單」到「關鍵參數確認」
blocks.en: 2.3 Risk assessment: from a "list of possible impacts" to "confirmation of critical parameters"

blocks.zh: 風險評估在製劑開發中是一個迭代過程：
blocks.en: Risk assessment in drug product development is an iterative process:

blocks.zh: 初始風險評估（開發早期）：基於先驗知識，列出所有可能影響 CQA 的物料屬性和製程參數——清單通常很長
blocks.en: Initial risk assessment (early development): based on prior knowledge, list all material attributes and process parameters that may affect CQAs; this list is usually long

blocks.zh: 風險排序：用 FMEA、Fishbone、風險矩陣篩選高優先級參數
blocks.en: Risk ranking: use FMEA, fishbone diagrams, and risk matrices to screen for high-priority parameters

blocks.zh: 實驗驗證（DoE）：確認哪些參數真正對 CQA 有統計顯著影響
blocks.en: Experimental verification (DoE): confirm which parameters have a statistically significant effect on CQAs

blocks.zh: 持續更新：隨開發進展重複評估，清單逐漸聚焦
blocks.en: Continuous updating: repeat the assessment as development progresses, so the list becomes progressively more focused

blocks.zh: 最終確認的「顯著參數」成為 CPP，進入 Design Space 設計。
blocks.en: The "significant parameters" finally confirmed become CPPs and enter the Design Space design.

blocks.zh: 2.4.5 最常見誤解：PAR 組合 ≠ Design Space
blocks.en: 2.4.5 The most common misunderstanding: a combination of PARs is not a Design Space

blocks.zh: 這是 Q8 最重要的澄清之一：
blocks.en: This is one of the most important clarifications in Q8:

blocks.zh: PAR（Proven Acceptable Range）：單一參數的可接受範圍，通過單變數實驗確定（univariate），不考慮其他參數的影響
blocks.en: PAR (Proven Acceptable Range): the acceptable range of a single parameter, established by univariate experiments without considering the effect of other parameters

blocks.zh: Design Space：多個 CPP 和物料屬性的多維交互空間，考慮參數間的交互作用，通過 DoE 等多變數實驗確定
blocks.en: Design Space: a multidimensional, interactive space of multiple CPPs and material attributes, which accounts for interactions among parameters and is established by multivariate experiments such as DoE

blocks.zh: 例如：造粒水量的 PAR 是 15-25%，噴霧速率的 PAR 是 5-10 g/min。但這兩個 PAR 的組合（長方形區域）不等於 Design Space——因為在某些組合（高水量+高噴霧速率）下品質可能不可接受。
blocks.en: For example: the PAR for granulation water is 15-25%, and the PAR for spray rate is 5-10 g/min. But the combination of these two PARs (a rectangular region) is not equal to the Design Space, because quality may be unacceptable under certain combinations (high water + high spray rate).

blocks.zh: 類比：DS vs PAR 的差別
blocks.en: Analogy: DS vs PAR

blocks.zh:
想像一棟房子的安全承重範圍：
PAR 方法 = 只測試每根柱子的最大承重（個別）
DS 方法 = 測試所有柱子組合下的結構整體承重（考慮柱子間的支撐交互作用）
blocks.en:
Imagine the safe load-bearing range of a house:
PAR approach = testing only the maximum load of each column (individually)
DS approach = testing the overall structural load under all column combinations (considering the supporting interactions among columns)

blocks.zh: 顯然 DS 提供了更準確的「安全操作空間」理解。
blocks.en: Clearly, the DS gives a more accurate understanding of the "safe operating space".

blocks.zh: 2.4.4 比例放大（Scale-up）的尺度無關參數
blocks.en: 2.4.4 Scale-up and scale-independent parameters

blocks.zh: 當 DS 需要跨越實驗室、試量產、商業生產規模時，必須用尺度無關參數（scale-independent parameters）描述：
blocks.en: When a DS must span laboratory, pilot and commercial manufacturing scales, it must be described using scale-independent parameters:

blocks.zh: 攪拌敏感性製品：用剪切速率（shear rate）而非轉速（RPM）
blocks.en: Agitation-sensitive products: use shear rate rather than rotational speed (RPM)

blocks.zh: 乾燥過程：用無因次數（Dimensionless numbers）如 Froude number
blocks.en: Drying processes: use dimensionless numbers such as the Froude number

blocks.zh: 凍乾製品：用時間-溫度-壓力曲線的函數形式
blocks.en: Lyophilized products: use the functional form of the time-temperature-pressure profile

blocks.zh: 這允許同一 DS 在不同規模設備上有效適用，支持商業化後的製造彈性。
blocks.en: This allows the same DS to be valid on equipment of different scales, supporting manufacturing flexibility after commercialization.

blocks.zh: Annex 2.5, 2.6 & Section 3: Control Strategy, Lifecycle & CTD Submission｜控制策略、生命週期管理與 CTD 提交
blocks.en: Annex 2.5, 2.6 & Section 3: Control Strategy, Lifecycle & CTD Submission

blocks.zh: RTRT（Real-Time Release Testing）即時放行測試
blocks.en: RTRT (Real-Time Release Testing)

blocks.zh: RTRT 是 QbD 帶來的最大製造效益之一——以製程中的即時量測取代部分終點測試：
blocks.en: RTRT is one of the greatest manufacturing benefits of QbD: real-time in-process measurements replace some end-product testing:

blocks.zh: 條件：已建立 PAT 量測與 CQA 之間的可靠數學模型
blocks.en: Condition: a reliable mathematical model has been established between the PAT measurement and the CQA

blocks.zh: 例子：NIR 即時測定含量均勻性 → 取代傳統 content uniformity 測試
blocks.en: Example: real-time NIR determination of content uniformity replaces the traditional content uniformity test

blocks.zh: 限制：RTRT 可取代終點測試，但不能取代 GMP 要求的批次審核和品管放行步驟
blocks.en: Limitation: RTRT can replace end-product testing but cannot replace the batch review and QA release steps required by GMP

blocks.zh: 益處：更快放行、更高品質保證（連續數據 vs 抽樣測試）
blocks.en: Benefits: faster release and higher quality assurance (continuous data vs sampled testing)

blocks.zh: 類比：控制策略如同多層防禦
blocks.en: Analogy: the control strategy as multilayer defense

blocks.zh: 控制策略如同機場安全系統——不依賴單一關卡，而是多層防禦：邊境管制（輸入物料）→ 行李 X 光（製程 IPC）→ 人身安檢（製程中測試）→ 登機口驗證（終點測試）。每層防禦針對不同風險，整體確保「不合格品不會到達乘客手中（患者手中）」。
blocks.en: The control strategy is like airport security: it does not rely on a single checkpoint but on multiple layers of defense: border control (incoming materials), baggage X-ray (in-process IPC), personal screening (in-process testing), boarding gate verification (end-product testing). Each layer addresses a different risk, and together they ensure that "non-conforming product never reaches the passenger (the patient)".

blocks.zh: Design Space 變更的監管要求
blocks.en: Regulatory requirements for Design Space changes

blocks.zh: Q8 Annex 2.6 明確：Design Space 的變更（擴大、縮小、重新定義）受各地區法規要求管轄。這意味著：
blocks.en: Q8 Annex 2.6 states clearly that changes to a Design Space (expansion, reduction, or redefinition) are subject to regional regulatory requirements. This means:

blocks.zh: Design Space 一旦獲批，不可任意更改
blocks.en: Once approved, a Design Space cannot be changed arbitrarily

blocks.zh: 獲批後的知識更新（如模型維護）若不改變 DS 本身，可在公司品質體系內管理（無需監管申報）
blocks.en: Post-approval knowledge updates (such as model maintenance) that do not change the DS itself can be managed within the company quality system (no regulatory filing required)

blocks.zh: 希望擴大 DS 範圍 → 需按 post-approval change 流程申報
blocks.en: To expand the DS range, a filing under the post-approval change process is required

blocks.zh: 這是 DS「靈活但有邊界」特性的體現。
blocks.en: This reflects the DS characteristic of being "flexible but with boundaries".

blocks.zh: 自我測試
blocks.en: Self-Test

blocks.zh: 一個固體口服製劑，QTPP 中定義了「快速溶出（>85% in 30 min）」的目標，應如何推導相關 CQA？
blocks.en: For an oral solid dosage form whose QTPP defines a target of "rapid dissolution (>85% in 30 min)", how should the related CQAs be derived?

blocks.zh: 為何 PAR 的組合不等於 Design Space？舉一個具體例子說明其差別。
blocks.en: Why is a combination of PARs not equal to a Design Space? Give a specific example to illustrate the difference.

blocks.zh: Control Strategy 的第幾層（RTRT）有什麼使用限制？RTRT 可以完全取代 QC 批次審核嗎？
blocks.en: Which layer of the Control Strategy is RTRT, and what limitations apply to its use? Can RTRT completely replace QC batch review?

blocks.zh: 若要將一個在試量產規模建立的 Design Space 應用於商業規模，如何描述比例放大的科學依據？
blocks.en: To apply a Design Space established at pilot scale to commercial scale, how should the scientific rationale for scale-up be described?

blocks.zh: 控制策略（Control Strategy）的完整框架
blocks.en: The complete framework of the Control Strategy

blocks.zh: 控制策略是 QbD 的「操作化」——將科學知識轉化為實際的製造控制措施。完整的控制策略包含五個層次：
blocks.en: The control strategy is the "operationalization" of QbD: it translates scientific knowledge into actual manufacturing controls. A complete control strategy contains five layers:

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Key Takeaways
blocks.en: Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: Annex 定位：不建立新要求，而是展示 QbD 概念的實際應用；知識品質 > 數據數量
blocks.en: Annex positioning: establishes no new requirements, but shows practical application of QbD concepts; quality of knowledge > quantity of data

blocks.zh: QbD 最小要素：QTPP → CQA → 製程選擇 → 控制策略（所有申請均應具備）
blocks.en: Minimal QbD elements: QTPP → CQA → process selection → control strategy (all submissions should have these)

blocks.zh: 增強 QbD：+風險評估 + 功能關係建立 + Design Space + RTRT（帶來監管彈性）
blocks.en: Enhanced QbD: + risk assessment + establishment of functional relationships + Design Space + RTRT (bringing regulatory flexibility)

blocks.zh: QTPP：製劑設計的起點和願景，驅動所有後續開發決策
blocks.en: QTPP: the starting point and vision of drug product design, driving all subsequent development decisions

blocks.zh: CQA：必須在適當限度內的物理/化學/生物/微生物屬性；從 QTPP 推導；清單動態更新
blocks.en: CQA: physical/chemical/biological/microbiological attributes that must be within appropriate limits; derived from the QTPP; the list is updated dynamically

blocks.zh: 風險評估（2.3）：迭代過程，從廣泛清單聚焦至 CPP；DoE 驗證顯著性
blocks.en: Risk assessment (2.3): an iterative process, narrowing from a broad list to CPPs; DoE verifies significance

blocks.zh: Design Space（2.4）：多維交互空間；PAR 組合 ≠ DS；可跨單元操作或跨比例；比例放大需尺度無關參數
blocks.en: Design Space (2.4): a multidimensional interactive space; PAR combination ≠ DS; can span unit operations or scales; scale-up requires scale-independent parameters

blocks.zh: 控制策略（2.5）：五層防禦（輸入→製程→IPC→終點→RTRT）；RTRT 取代部分終點測試但不取代 GMP 放行程序
blocks.en: Control strategy (2.5): five layers of defense (inputs → process → IPC → end-product → RTRT); RTRT replaces some end-product testing but not the GMP release procedure

blocks.zh: Design Space 變更受各地區法規管轄；DS 本身不變的模型維護可在公司品質體系內處理
blocks.en: Design Space changes are governed by regional regulations; model maintenance that leaves the DS itself unchanged can be handled within the company quality system
